Clear Creek
MMATPATAAZENН ОРСЕУРНЯ ШIMI
1. The faces of cut and fill slopes shall be prepared and maintained to control against
erosion.
2. This control shall consist of effective planting as a permanent control measure.
3. Permanent soil stabilization measures shall be installed within thirty (30) days after final
grade is reached. Planting shall occur within the next window of opportunity should
construction be completed during winter months.
4. Were cut slopes are not subject to erosion due to the erosion-resistant character of the
materials, such protection may be omitted.
5. Where necessary, check dams, cribbing, riprap, or other devices or methods shall be
employed to control erosion and provide safety.
6. Preserve existing trees, shrubs and grasses where possible to prevent erosion.
7. No work may interfere with the flow of storm water.
8. Excavations shall be constructed so they are stable.
9. Storm water runoff shall be discharged from the site in quantities and at velocities not
to exceed historic levels.
10. All erosion control devices shall be maintained so that they function as designed.
11. Dust emissions (wind erosion) shall be controlled.
12. Temporary erosion protection shall be installed prior to excavation.
13. All topsoil shall be salvaged and redistributed.
14. Road crossings across water courses designated as "Waters of the United States" must
meet the requirements set forth by the Army Corps of Engineers for permitting before a
County permit will be issued.
